passages.title: The First Eyewitness
text: I was looking at the Monalisa, and someone threw a cake at the painting.
I turned around and saw an old man.
He was standing in front of a wheelchair.
I’m about 170 cm tall, and he was a little taller than me.
koreanText: 저는 ‘모나리자’를 보고 있었는데, 누군가 그 그림을 향해 케이크를 던졌어요.
저는 뒤로 돌았고 한 노인을 봤어요.
저는 키가 170cm 정도인데, 그는 저보다 조금 더 컸어요.
